items.subject: Spanish couples dancing in a grand ballroom, among them a mid-20s Spanish man of slim build in a dark suit and a mid-20s Spanish woman of slight build in a modest early-1960s cocktail dress
items.action: couples circle the parquet floor in a slow dance as an orchestra plays
items.gaze_interaction: the young pair turned toward each other at arm's length, other dancers read as silhouettes and backs
items.setting: ornate ballroom of a Madrid arts club, 1961, tall mirrors, gilded moldings, high windows to a night street
items.color_palette: warm gold, ivory, deep burgundy velvet, black evening suits
items.props_detail: a crystal chandelier blazing above the dance floor
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from a balcony
items.lighting: warm tungsten chandelier light, low-key night
items.mood: soft warm glow, relaxed shoulders, couples close and unhurried
items.narration_anchor: Dieciséis de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y uno. En el salón de baile del Círculo de Bellas Artes de Madrid, Daniel Écija conoce a María Bernal.

items.subject: a newlywed Spanish couple, late-20s man of lean build in a borrowed dark suit, mid-20s woman of slight build in a simple white dress, seen small on church steps
items.action: the couple descends the stone steps of a Madrid parish church after the wedding as a few relatives scatter rice
items.gaze_interaction: the couple seen from behind and in profile, heads tilted toward each other
items.setting: modest Madrid parish church on a Thursday in September 1962, worn stone facade, narrow working-class street
items.color_palette: pale limestone, dusty ochre, black and grey Sunday clothes, one white dress
items.props_detail: a small bouquet of white flowers held at the bride's side
items.mood: gentle sunlight on stone, relatives gathered close, unhurried steps
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: hundreds of Spanish emigrants of all ages, men in shirtsleeves and caps, women in plain cotton dresses, filling the rails of a white ocean liner
items.action: the emigrants crowd the deck rails as the liner prepares to cast off from the quay
items.gaze_interaction: most figures seen from behind and in profile, looking back toward the shore
items.setting: Spanish port quay, September 1962, cranes, cargo sheds, mooring ropes
items.color_palette: white hull, rust streaks, faded cotton blues and greys, pale Mediterranean sky
items.props_detail: battered cardboard suitcases tied with string stacked by the gangway
items.mood: dense crowd pressed shoulder to shoulder, bright steady light, waiting stillness
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: a young Spanish couple, late-20s man of lean build and mid-20s woman of slight build, in sun-faded 1960s travel clothes
items.action: the couple stands together at the stern rail as the ship moves into open sea
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, both facing the empty horizon, her shoulder against his arm
items.setting: stern deck of an emigrant liner, 1962, open sea, churning white wake
items.color_palette: deep sea blue, white painted steel, faded cotton, pale sky
items.props_detail: a single worn leather suitcase at their feet
items.mood: two small figures before a vast flat horizon, still posture, wind in clothes
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: a mid-20s Spanish woman of slight build in a plain cotton dress and cardigan, beside a late-20s Spanish man of lean build in shirtsleeves
items.action: the woman walks the crowded deck pressed close against her husband's side, her arm hooked through his
items.gaze_interaction: her face toward the front, chin lifted, eyes forward past the camera; his face turned toward her
items.setting: crowded promenade deck of an emigrant liner, 1962, lifeboats and rails behind
items.color_palette: faded cotton blue, cream, white steel, sea grey
items.props_detail: a small handbag clutched against her coat
items.mood: bodies held close, head up, steady stride through the crowd
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: two young Spanish couples from Madrid, men in their late 20s with work-hardened builds in dusty shirts, women in their mid-20s in sun-faded cotton dresses
items.action: the two couples sit together on a small veranda sharing an evening meal
items.gaze_interaction: one woman laughing toward the other, men leaning in, faces lit warmly from the side
items.setting: veranda of a corrugated iron and asbestos-cement house in a desert mining town, 1963, red earth yard
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, faded green paint, grey sheeting, dusty blue dusk sky
items.props_detail: a shared enamel pot on a small wooden table
items.mood: relaxed shoulders, chairs pulled close, warm low sun on dusty faces
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about eight, thin build, in short trousers and a sweat-damp shirt, small on a sun-blasted deck
items.action: the boy sits in the narrow strip of shade under a lifeboat as heat shimmers off the deck
items.gaze_interaction: head tilted back against the bulkhead, eyes half-closed toward the glaring sky
items.setting: open upper deck of an emigrant liner in tropical waters, 1962
items.color_palette: bleached white steel, hard black shadow, pale burning sky
items.props_detail: a dented metal water cup beside the boy
items.mood: glaring white light, heat haze, a small body pressed into the only shade
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about eight, thin build, in his best shorts and pressed shirt, beside his Spanish mother in her late 20s in a dark dress
items.action: the boy climbs the steep gangway onto the ship holding his mother's hand
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind and below, the boy's head turned up toward the towering hull
items.setting: Málaga harbor quay, summer 1962, white liner hull rising above
items.color_palette: white hull, rusted rivets, Mediterranean blue, sun-bleached stone
items.props_detail: a small cardboard suitcase in the boy's free hand
items.mood: a small figure dwarfed by the steel wall of the ship, steady upward steps
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: a white emigrant liner leaving port
items.action: the liner pulls away from the harbor breakwater toward open sea, trailing smoke
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction toward the departing ship and the widening water
items.setting: Málaga harbor, summer 1962, lighthouse, breakwater, white town and hills behind
items.color_palette: Mediterranean blue, white hull, ochre hills, pale sky
items.props_detail: a thin plume of dark funnel smoke
items.mood: vast calm water, a small ship growing smaller, steady light
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: an emigrant liner gliding through a narrow desert canal, Spanish passengers crowded under canvas awnings
items.action: the ship slides between sand banks as passengers fan themselves in the shade
items.gaze_interaction: figures read as silhouettes under awnings, facing the endless sand
items.setting: Suez Canal, 1962, flat sand desert on both banks, heat shimmer
items.color_palette: pale sand, bleached white hull, washed-out blue sky, narrow green water
items.props_detail: sagging canvas awnings stretched over the deck
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, heat haze
items.mood: shimmering heat, slumped figures in thin shade, blinding sand
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about eight, thin, pale and sweat-damp, slumped on a deck bench beside his Spanish mother in her late 20s
items.action: the boy leans heavily against his mother as the deck rolls in a swell
items.gaze_interaction: boy's head on her shoulder, eyes closed; mother's face turned toward the empty horizon
items.setting: crowded lower deck of an emigrant liner, 1962, rail and grey sea behind
items.color_palette: sea grey, chipped white paint, faded cotton blues
items.props_detail: a damp folded handkerchief in the mother's lap
items.lighting: harsh tropical-bright daylight dulled by sea haze
items.mood: tilted horizon, limp posture, mother's arm wrapped around the boy
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: a small twin-propeller passenger plane of the early 1960s
items.action: the plane banks and lurches through turbulent hot air over the desert
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the tilted wings toward the red land below
items.setting: sky above the Pilbara, Western Australia, 1962, red ranges and gorges far below
items.color_palette: deep red earth, ochre ridges, dusty blue sky, silver aluminium
items.props_detail: spinning propellers blurred against the sky
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, slight motion blur on props
items.mood: tilted wings, heat haze rising from the land, an empty endless red below
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: a small twin-propeller plane touching down on a remote desert airstrip
items.action: the plane lands and throws up a huge cloud of red and grey dust across the strip
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the dusty runway toward a lone corrugated shed
items.setting: desert airstrip in the Pilbara, 1962, surfaced with mine waste, red ranges on the horizon
items.color_palette: deep red earth, ochre, blue-grey tinted dust, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a faded windsock beside a corrugated iron shed
items.camera_angle: low angle from the strip edge
items.mood: dust hanging in the air, heat shimmer, a tiny machine in a vast red land
items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: a newly arrived Spanish family, father in his late 20s of lean build, mother in her late 20s, a boy of about eight, dust settling on their travel clothes
items.action: the family walks with suitcases along a dusty road toward a row of new houses
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, the boy's head turned toward the dust swirling around his feet
items.setting: active desert mining town, 1962, fresh corrugated iron, timber and asbestos-cement sheet houses on a grey-blue tailings road
items.color_palette: red earth, grey sheeting, silver corrugated iron, blue-grey dust, clear dusty sky
items.props_detail: a cardboard suitcase coated in fine dust
items.mood: dust drifting in the air, small figures before identical houses, slow heavy steps
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: miners in dusty work clothes and cloth caps, European and Australian men in their 20s to 40s of wiry build, small beside a mill and its waste heaps
items.action: trucks dump fresh blue asbestos tailings beside the mill as miners walk through the haze
items.gaze_interaction: workers seen from behind and as silhouettes, faces turned down against the dust
items.setting: asbestos mill at the mouth of a red rock gorge, 1962, conveyors and sheds
items.color_palette: red rock, ochre, blue-grey tailings, grey dust haze
items.props_detail: a battered dump truck tipping its load
items.lighting: harsh midday desert sun filtered by dust
items.mood: air thick with suspended dust, small figures under towering heaps
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: Spanish children of about six to nine, thin, barefoot, in faded shorts and dresses, with a Spanish mother in her late 20s in a doorway
items.action: the children play in the blue asbestos tailings of a house yard, kicking up a fine cloud
items.gaze_interaction: children absorbed in the ground, the mother's face toward the front watching from the doorway, dust on her apron
items.setting: yard of a corrugated iron and asbestos-cement house in the mining town, 1962
items.color_palette: blue-grey tailings, red earth, faded paint, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a child's tin bucket half filled with blue fibrous waste
items.mood: fine dust glowing in sunlight, children kneeling in it, the mother standing still in the shade
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
